attribution_caveat: Feature attribution describes how a fitted model used its inputs to produce a risk score. It reflects model association and contribution within this dataset. It is NOT evidence of medical causation, NOT a diagnostic finding, and NOT a clinically validated interpretation. Correlated features can share or dilute attribution between themselves.
baseline_for_shap: the explainer's expected output for each model (E[f(x)]), not the mean SHAP value; base + sum(contributions) reproduces the model's own output, verified numerically for every explained case and for the whole sample

output_scale.note: magnitudes are NOT comparable across model families: compare signs and within-model rankings only
